files.content:
"use client";

import { Avatar, Group, Indicator } from '@mantine/core';

function Demo() {
  return (
    <Group>
      <Indicator inline label="99" color="lime.4">
        <Avatar
          size="lg"
          radius="xl"
          src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mantinedev/mantine/master/.demo/avatars/avatar-1.png"
        />
      </Indicator>

      <Indicator inline label="99" color="lime.4" autoContrast>
        <Avatar
          size="lg"
          radius="xl"
          src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mantinedev/mantine/master/.demo/avatars/avatar-2.png"
        />
      </Indicator>

      <Indicator inline label="99" color="cyan.9">
        <Avatar
          size="lg"
          radius="xl"
          src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mantinedev/mantine/master/.demo/avatars/avatar-3.png"
        />
      </Indicator>

      <Indicator inline label="99" color="cyan.9" autoContrast>
        <Avatar
          size="lg"
          radius="xl"
          src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mantinedev/mantine/master/.demo/avatars/avatar-4.png"
        />
      </Indicator>
    </Group>
  );
}
const RendynExampleComponent = Demo;
export function RendynExample() { return <RendynExampleComponent  />; }

# Mantine indicator

8 published Mantine indicator examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Complete MIT usage examples extracted from the upstream demo code template; documentation configurator machinery is excluded.
- Mount MantineProvider once at your client application root and import @mantine/core/styles.css. The returned preview wrapper is a standalone example; reuse an existing provider when integrating.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
